context: Go 1.24 CLI/TUI with an embedded React web UI. Repo layout: `internal/app` owns CLI routing and config application, `internal/args` parses flags and help text, `internal/workflow` drives PRD generation/implementation, `internal/shared/prd` owns the JSON document model plus load/save/validation, `internal/prompt/templates` holds embedded prompt templates, `web/` is the Vite + Vitest app, and `e2e/` is Playwright. Exact test commands already documented in the repo are `go test ./...`, `cd web && npm test`, `cd e2e && npx playwright test`, and `go generate ./internal/web/...` after web UI changes. Conventions observed nearby: table-driven Go tests in `_test.go` files, unit tests live beside the code they cover, errors are wrapped with concrete context, config defaults come from `config.DefaultConfig()`, prompts use machine-readable kind markers, and JSON models use `omitempty` where empty fields should disappear. The existing PRD flow is slice-based, with `behavior`, `red_hint`, and optional `refactor_hint`, so new planning artifacts should follow the same additive, small-slice style and keep changes localized rather than introducing drive-by refactors.
test_spec: Generate a product document from a normal repo and confirm it writes `product.json` instead of `prd.json`; reject or preserve incompatible fields so the product artifact stays free of implementation details like context, test specs, red hints, and refactor hints; keep the normal PRD flow untouched so existing `--dry-run` / PRD review behavior still works; surface the new mode in CLI help and in any TUI/web status copy that names the output file; keep round-trips and validation deterministic so saving then loading a product document preserves only the allowed product-level fields.

stories.title: Defining the product document
stories.description: Extend the existing planning document model in `internal/shared/prd` so product-mode output has its own JSON shape and validation rules. Add a `product.json` file path to config defaults if the implementation needs a separate filename, and make load/save helpers round-trip the new document without carrying over technical planning fields. Keep the current `prd.json` schema and validation behavior unchanged for normal PRD runs.

slices.behavior: Saving and loading a product document preserves only product-level fields and omits implementation-only fields from the JSON payload.
slices.red_hint: Add a unit test that fails if the product JSON still contains `context`, `test_spec`, `red_hint`, or `refactor_hint` after a save/load round-trip.

slices.behavior: Product validation rejects documents that include technical planning details.
slices.red_hint: Add a validation test that feeds a product document with implementation details and expects a clear error instead of accepting it.

slices.behavior: The current PRD schema still round-trips exactly as before.
slices.red_hint: Add a regression test proving existing `prd.json` save/load behavior does not change when product support is introduced.

stories.title: Wiring the product mode through the CLI and generator
stories.description: Add a `--product` flag in `internal/args`, route it through `internal/app/coordinator.go`, and teach `internal/workflow/phase_generate.go` and `internal/prompt` to generate `product.json` with product-focused instructions. The new prompt should ask for product-level outcomes only and explicitly avoid technical or implementation details. Update help text and validation so the new mode is discoverable and behaves consistently with the existing generation flow.

slices.behavior: `--product` parses cleanly and appears in CLI help text as a dedicated generation mode.
slices.red_hint: Add an args test that fails until `--product` is recognized and documented in `HelpText()`.

slices.behavior: The coordinator routes product mode to the generation path with the product filename instead of the PRD filename.
slices.red_hint: Add a coordinator test that fails if product mode still hardcodes `prd.json` or falls through to the normal PRD flow.

slices.behavior: The product-generation prompt forbids technical implementation details and names the product output file.
slices.red_hint: Add a prompt test that fails if the product prompt still mentions `context`, `test_spec`, `red_hint`, `refactor_hint`, or `prd.json`.

stories.title: Surfacing product mode in the UI and tests
stories.description: Update the TUI and web-facing document loading paths so product runs show the correct filename and status copy without breaking the existing PRD review flow. Add focused tests in the nearby Go, Vitest, and Playwright suites to prove the new mode is visible end to end and that normal PRD behavior still works.

slices.behavior: TUI failure and completion copy names `product.json` when product mode is active.
slices.red_hint: Add a TUI view test that fails if the UI still hardcodes `prd.json` in product-mode status messages.

slices.behavior: The web loader can fetch and render the product document without regressing the existing PRD loader.
slices.red_hint: Add a web or hook test that fails if product mode cannot load its document or if the existing PRD review path breaks.

slices.behavior: An end-to-end test can start product mode and observe the generated artifact flow.
slices.red_hint: Add a Playwright or integration test that fails until product mode is visible from the user-facing run flow.
